summary: Clear progress since w7. The flap is now one thin sheet, the wings are pads rather than beans, the aisle shroud is dark, the fabric crown is hidden behind the rim, saturation is right, and the light flecks no longer dominate the back cloth. It is still not the same product at a glance, for three reasons. (1) The headrest wings sit IN FRONT of the flap and cover its edges, so the navy reads as a narrow vertical strip in a channel. In every ANA photo the flap lies over the wings and is a near-square panel. (2) The stowed goosenecks hang at about 35 deg with thick black arms crossing the wing. ANA's hang straight down along the shell flank. (3) The back cloth now reads as regular horizontal corduroy rows rather than ANA's fine irregular brick mosaic.

issues.issue: The back cloth reads as regular horizontal corduroy stripes. The tile's rows are strictly periodic, so at cabin distance they beat into visible bands. ANA's dash grid reads as a fine, irregular brick mosaic with no row striping.
issues.evidence: The tex/tex_py_back.png row-profile autocorrelation is 0.91 at a 12.8 px lag (20 identical-pitch rows). On q14, the vertical high-pass autocorrelation (9 px box) is +0.43/+0.29/+0.29 at lags 1/4/5 and +0.28 at lag 9. On q13 it is +0.35/+0.32 at lags 4/8. On py_37301 every lag is within +-0.11. Gradient energy (v/h) is q14 20/13 against 37301 33/20. Side by side: /tmp/claude-0/w8a/fab.png.
issues.fix: test/make_swatches.py synth_py_back: give each row its own pitch. Make row heights random in N(ph, 0.18*ph), renormalised so the sum is S (keeps it tileable), and set each band centre yc_r from the cumulative sum. Add a per-cell vertical jitter of the dash band of +-0.12*ph (uniform). Lower the row-to-row band contrast by adding 0.18 to the inter-row ground (out = ground*(0.82 + 0.18*u) where u is weave noise), so rows stop forming dark gutters. Target: q14 |ac| at lags 2-10 < 0.15, and local skew < 0.2.
